content: Even a tiny earthen oil lamp can dispel the pitch darkness of a thousand-year-old cavern.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Dipo bhakshayate dhvantam — Traditional Sanskrit Subhashita
explanation: It matters not if a cave has been submerged in blackness since the dawn of the world; the darkness has zero thickness or substance. The instant a seeker strikes a tiny clay lamp, thousands of years of shadow vanish in a single microsecond. Truth is infinitely more substantial than confusion.
practicalInsight: Never be intimidated by how entrenched an old bad habit or systemic problem seems. Strike a single flame of clear action.
reflectionPrompt: What dark area of fear in your life could be completely dispelled if you simply brought the lamp of honest awareness to it?
